label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — although encodeForHTML is applied to fileName, the instruction mandates preferring alert-TP when attacker-controlled data remains the resolved sink value. Alert 2 (java/path-injection): alert-TP — fileName is constructed from TESTFILES_DIR + bar, where bar derives from user-controlled header names without validation, enabling path traversal. Both alerts indicate real vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: Parameter extraction from request headers; param is set to the name of the first non-standard header.
doSomething returns param as bar; fileName is constructed by concatenating TESTFILES_DIR with bar.
XSS sink: fileName is passed to encodeForHTML and printed to response writer.
Path injection sink: fileName is used directly in FileOutputStream constructor.
